obligations.behavior: Route mixed local/global SIMD warp lanes per MEM_ATTR_LOCAL_OFFS without duplicating or dropping beats under asymmetric downstream stalls, and merge local/global responses cleanly.

Serve 2-lane 64-bit LSU accesses, RV64A .W/.D atomics and LR/SC, and 512-bit DMA bursts across 8 RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x64_c2_bm_bist macros without DMA-AMO RMW corruption, stalled-response clobbering, byte-mask mis-expansion, idle A_MEN leakage, or simultaneous A_WEN/A_REN.

Place all 8 SRAM macros legally inside core bounds, constrain clk <= 20.0 ns with >= 1.5 ns I/O delays, and close OpenROAD PDN, post-GRT WNS/hold >= 0.0 ns, overflow <= 25, and wirelength <= 7,800,000 um.
